findings.title: HTTP success commits before cookie
findings.evidence: Login and ChangePassword invoke writeJSON before setSessionCookie. writeJSON calls WriteHeader; Result().Cookies/browser receives no session cookie. Set cookie before committing successful response and exercise real positive handler flow.

findings.title: Restored CSRF unusable and password request omits it
findings.evidence: Session returns csrf.token empty, violating identity schema minLength16. acceptNativeSession overwrites CSRF with empty. changeNativePasswordRequest has no requestOptions(undefined,true), so even fresh-login CSRF is omitted. Recover a stable session-bound CSRF safely; never persist raw token; assert restore/read then authenticated write and same-session refresh continuity.

findings.title: Migration45 removes existing preauth RLS access
findings.evidence: Replacement credentials policy lacks find_login_account used by the existing login function. Replacement accounts policy lacks record_password_failure and revoke_session WITH CHECK. Under FORCE RLS/NOINHERIT native login cannot see credentials and writes lose required access. Restore only exact operation privileges, preserve spoof rejection and direct table denial; do not edit executed44.

findings.title: Mutating SQL functions yield no result row
findings.evidence: revoke_native_session and change_own_password RETURNS TABLE set OUT variables but contain no RETURN NEXT/RETURN QUERY. QueryRow.Scan receives no rows after committed function mutation. Return actual row; translate SQLSTATE40001/28000/validation errors to repository sentinels so HTTP409/401/400 are accurate.

findings.title: Session version and absolute boundary missing
findings.evidence: No issued_session_version is stored/compared; account session version changes do not invalidate other sessions. touch uses least(absolute,now+ttl), conflicting with existing strict absolute>idle CHECK near expiry. Define version semantics consistently, record/compare issued value, handle equality at expiry in forward45 only.

findings.title: Password mutation and audit recheck incomplete
findings.evidence: Password credential/session rotation is atomic in SQL, but p_old_session_id is not checked in its body; an expired/revoked old session can pass after middleware check. Login/logout/password audit runs separately and every error is discarded; success can lack audit. Recheck locked account+actual old session active/version/expiry and successful password proof version in the write transaction; audit and mutation must commit together or both fail, including unique audit event IDs.

findings.title: Rate fence uses stale pre-read count and no entry bound
findings.evidence: Lock threshold is decided from prior failed_count outside atomic increment, losing threshold under concurrency. Unknown-user path returns without equivalent bounded password verification cost; per-name rows alone permit username spray and have no entry-wide admission fence. Persistence errors ignored. Implement account+entry durable concurrent reservation/limit, equivalent unknown rejection behavior and explicit fence-error handling; keep costs bounded.

findings.title: Native authorization projection changes scope semantics
findings.evidence: Cluster UID is parsed as registered cluster ID without registry mapping. One cluster with multiple namespaces passes validation but projects zero namespaces. Operator-only Web loads platform_admin-only getClusters, receiving403; empty allowed set includes all returned clusters. First-only JSON also returns grants although middleware removes roles. Project server-authorized UID/ID scope via existing service/session mechanism with separate roles, retain every namespace or fail closed; first-only returns no business grants. Do not grant admin to fix operator login or implement unrelated P2-04 administration.

findings.title: Native lifecycle can resurrect expired/logged-out state
findings.evidence: expireIdentity/logout do not advance generation; native refreshes overlap using same generation. acceptNativeSession mutates credentials/loggedOut before current check. Native mode has no authEvents expired/forbidden listeners. Native logout without a session falls through getManager. Native initial render also starts OIDC manager before config resolves, while loadAuthMode silently falls back to OIDC on config failure. Gate mode until known/fail closed; subscribe native events; serialize/version refresh and invalidate before logout; gate every side effect and credential commit. Same session refresh stays valid; real change aborts old HTTP/SSE/cache. OIDC addUserLoaded anonymous callback removed with different function must be corrected.

findings.title: Middleware drops request cancellation and cookie-write origin coverage
findings.evidence: requestContext builds on context.Background, losing original cancellation/deadline/values. Unsafe middleware checks CSRF but not origin; Logout has no origin check. Preserve r.Context and apply exact same-origin policy uniformly for cookie writes. Existing TLS termination must have explicit trusted deployment origin rules instead of trusting arbitrary forwarded headers. Remove tautological supplied-vs-itself comparison.
